notes.title: The Wild Lands Update is here
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28920011/6ab692f46969e91aaa25339048ffb1a27c982e7a.jpg[/img]

Hello,

Today we’re excited to bring you the Wild Lands Update. 

We’ve spent past months working hard on free update for Foxus, and the long wait for you is finally over.

Here’s a summary of what to expect:
[list]
    [*]New quests
[*]New locations to explore
[*]New gameplay mechanics
[*]Steam Achievements
[*]Reworked old locations
[*]Improved optimization (up to 30%)
[*]Gamepad controls improvements
[/list]
Foxus: The Wild Lands is out now and available for free to all Foxus players.

Thank you for staying with us throughout this journey. Have fun!

notes.title: Update 1.1: The Wild Lands - Coming Soon
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28920011/f2868333593a1dc1affafa890feb719cd686019a.jpg[/img]

Today we have an exciting announcement to share with all of you.

We're working on a massive update called The Wild Lands, which will bring new quests, activities, improvements and bugfixes to Foxus. We have been quiet because we were reading your feedback all the time to understand how we should approach this update, and now we're hard at work on it.

[h1]New Storyline[/h1]

Your adventures in Alandia continue with all-new quests and locations. Not only the update features new locations - past locations would be reworked as well. All-new story continues the main story of the game.

[h1]Collectables[/h1]

Collectables system is being largely reworked. For those who were worried, strawberries will make sense pretty soon. Same goes for the amount and placing of collectables on levels.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28920011/2b186ea9b13061756d52724e61876981e47665c0.jpg[/img]

[h1]Achievements[/h1]

We took our time to think about achievements, and they will be available in The Wild Lands update.

[h1]Improvements[/h1]

Of course this is just a small amount of things we're approaching right now. We're planning a lot of fixes towards collisions, savegames, performance and other game's systems to be included in this update.

The Wild Lands will release in April and will be available for free to all Foxus players.

We hope you enjoy what comes next!

notes.title: Roadmap
notes.content:
Hi all,

We'd like to see more of Foxus as much as you do, we'd like to improve it together with you - and this is the reason for this post!

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28920011/b6b5048eecabe615446bbc05335e81e90de94271.jpg[/img]

[h1]Work in progress[/h1]

Foxus Team is one-man indie - besides several very supportive people who are helping out with the translations - and I'm already doing the best I can.

We’ve now released 3 patches, and hopefully they really improve the experience for everybody, and I've finally got some sleep after working non-stop for the last 40 hours. We are still tracking more issues, and working hard to resolve them in the future updates. Thank you everyone who took their time to share their feedback about updates!

I understand that many players on Steam write negative reviews as a way to motivate developers to keep working on the game. In reality, those measures are having the reverse effect. This is not the case here - I am already super-motivated because I love this game!

I am very glad that you see the potential of the game, and I appreciate your patience and understanding. But please understand that I can't do everything at the once because the game is really massive for just one person.

[h1]Roadmap[/h1]

Now things are starting to get really interesting. While we still have to fix the issues you're experiencing, we have plans for the big content update - which will bring new activities to the game, improve collectable system and add more locations. We just need some time to think about it before diving into it.

So I have an important suggestion for everyone. Let's build our roadmap together. Please post your feedback /suggestions/any issues to the discussion on the Steam Forums. This way we can categorize all the issues and understand which features are critical for you. Also, we'd like to know what kind of activities would you like to see in the game.

http://steamcommunity.com/app/644130/discussions/0/1696040635906483588/

The future depends on you. And we hope you can join us in our journey!

Thank you,
Vladimir

notes.title: Patch 1.02.1
notes.content:
Hello!

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28920011/954f865fd9052dc0c06e97fa2dc762d8e3378fe6.png[/img]

Patch 1.02.1 is live now, and it brings somve very exciting and long-awaited options to the game.
[list]
[*]Camera Improvements. You can change camera sensitivity and turn on/off mouse camera smoothing, adjust FOV and switch to follow camera! 
[*]Sound. You can also now change sound volume in-game.
[*]Performance. You can now adjust FOV manually to get better FPS.
[/list]
We're still very hard at work and I am already working on the patch 1.02.2, hoping to bring controller support as soon as possible, so stay tuned! 

We'd love to bring more content to the game once tech issues and improvements are all resolved, so your comments, feedback and reviews are highly appreciated!

notes.title: Patch 1.01
notes.content:
Thank you to everyone who’s been playing Foxus!

Whilst many people are enjoying Foxus, we’re working hard to resolve issues you have as quickly as possible. We've been testing a game with PS4 gamepad for a while and while it should work OK now, we're not supporting controllers yet officially.

Patch 1.01 is live now and it addresses the following issues:
[list]
[*][b]Settings[/b]. Basic settings were added to the main menu.
[*][b]Follow Camera Mode[/b]. Follow Camera Mode can be activated via Settings Menu.
[*][b]Optimization[/b]. You can now turn on/off special effects via Settings Menu, getting 10%-20% better performance in-game.
[*][b]Critical bugfix[/b]. Fixed an issue with level event synchronization.
[*][b]Minor fixes.[/b]
[/list]

At this point, your support is greatly appreciated!

Thank you,
The Foxus Team

notes.title: Foxus release date, launch pricing, and more!
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

Today we have some big and very exciting news for you!

[h1]RELEASE DATE ANNOUNCEMENT TEASER TRAILER[/h1]
https://youtu.be/MrE12FRV4KQ

[h1]RELEASE DATE[/h1]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28920011/3e4a6fdd34ae0032580a7cfc29809656e2673158.png[/img]

We’re thrilled to announce that Foxus will be launching on February 27th.

The game will be available in English, Japanese, Russian and German language. We plan to bring more languages to the game in the future.

[h1]LAUNCH PRICING[/h1]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28920011/97c00e260e3453728a316ae9530dcd4d35d93f12.jpg[/img]

Foxus debuts on Steam on February 27th for [b]$9.99[/b]. For a limited time, anyone can get it at 20 percent off, bringing it down to [b]$7.99[/b]. If you own another one of our games, that discount jumps up to 50 percent, and that brings Foxus' price down to just [b]$4.99[/b].

*  *  *
Well, that's it for today. 

We’ll be a little quiet for a while because we’ve got some work to do before the game is ready. Foxus is a beautiful and enchanting game, and we look forward to revealing more details about it.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28920011/3231713a7dc96f38372704edd4cd1963ff6f7489.jpg[/img]

Thank you for all continued support. Let us know what you think in the comments down below!

Sincerely,
The Foxus Team
